name: line-ticker
title: Line ticker
description: A climbing line with the camera chasing its head and a large live number above it. Light or dark.

props.name: headline
props.doc: The claim that opens the shot, over the climbing line.

props.name: symbol
props.doc: Name on the ticker card (a wordmark, short).

props.name: domain
props.doc: Small line under the name on the ticker card.

props.name: from
props.doc: The number the ticker starts on.

props.name: to
props.doc: The number it has counted to when the shot ends.

props.name: deltaFrom
props.doc: Percent change shown under the number at the start.

props.name: person
props.doc: Name in the card that lands on the curve (the install).

props.name: item
props.doc: What they installed, second row of that card.

props.name: accent
props.doc: Gain colour: line, dot, pill. This is the design here, not a theme token.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: Extra seconds to hold on the last frame.

props.name: series
props.doc: Your own curve for the ticker half: y of the line (pixels in a 960x540 frame, larger is lower) every 4 px of world x. Leave out for the default curve.
